Resize a stopped instance's disk, memory, or vCPU count

Usage: iso resize [OPTIONS] <--size <SIZE>|--mem <MEM>|--vcpus <VCPUS>> [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]  Instance name (required if multiple instances exist)

Options:
      --size <SIZE>    New disk size: absolute GiB (e.g. 150, 150G) or relative (e.g. +20, +20G)
      --mem <MEM>      New memory in MiB (minimum 128)
      --vcpus <VCPUS>  New vCPU count
      --start          Start the instance after applying the change instead of leaving it stopped
  -h, --help           Print help
